previous_mapping.record_grain: One row per NPI facility record, keyed by the national facility_id; jurisdiction_code + jurisdiction_facility_id is the state-scoped facility identifier pair.
previous_mapping.grain_rationale: Byte inspection shows a single header row of 22 flat scalar fields with no nested arrays, so one row is one facility. facility_id is the nationally unique NPI facility identifier; jurisdiction_facility_id is only unique within jurisdiction_code and must never be used alone. Operator identity (registered_business_name, abn, acn) repeats across facility rows and is a separate business role, not a facility key.

record_id.rationale: facility_id is the national NPI facility identifier and is unique across jurisdictions; jurisdiction_code + jurisdiction_facility_id is retained as the state-scoped identifier pair but is not needed for the record key.

fields.rationale: facility_id is the national NPI facility identifier, unique across jurisdictions; establishment-owned, not the operator's ABN/ACN.
State-scoped NPI facility identifier; only unique within its jurisdiction, so the jurisdiction_code qualifier is carried with every claim.
NPI registration jurisdiction of the facility; distinct from the business address state and required as the qualifier for the jurisdiction-scoped facility id.
facility_name is the site/premises name; it is not unique and must not be conflated with registered_business_name.
latitude/longitude are facility coordinates; geo_point validates the pair lies inside Australia. Values may be rounded and do not assert exact site boundaries.
street_address is the facility street address; establishment-scoped address claim, not the operator's registered office.
suburb is the facility locality.
state is the facility address state; normalised to the state enum. The NPI registration jurisdiction is captured separately as dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_code.
postcode is the facility postcode; 4-digit AU postcode with NT re-padding.
Facility-level primary ANZSIC class code as stated by NPI; describes the facility, not the company-wide industry, so it stays establishment-owned.
Facility-level ANZSIC class label in the publisher's wording; not promoted to the operator.
Free-text facility activity statement kept verbatim; not converted into an invented industry code.
NPI reporting-year label of the first report; not an incorporation or licence date.
NPI reporting-year label of the most recent report; not a compliance or licence date.
Count of NPI reports for the facility; a report count, not an emissions measure or compliance indicator.
NPI identifier of the most recent report; identifies the report, not the facility.
Published report link only; embeds state/year/jurisdiction-facility path segments and is not a stable facility identifier.
registered_business_name is the operator/registered business entity name, not the facility name. It is the source's registered business name; legal form is not inferred from the name or ABN presence.
Operator ABN; checksum-validated, blank treated as missing. Presence of an ABN does not imply a particular legal form.
Operator ACN; checksum-validated, frequently blank. Not derived from the ABN.
Published website for the operator/facility; sanity-checked as a URL.

operator.rationale: The registered business name plus ABN/ACN identify the operator entity, which repeats across facility rows; it is a separate business role from the facility establishment.

relationships.rationale: Each NPI facility row states the registered business that operates the facility; the operator is a business role and the facility an establishment role.

previous_mapping.notes: All 22 columns are read. state is mapped to address.state for the facility address while jurisdiction_code is captured separately as the NPI registration jurisdiction, so the two are not conflated. facility_id is the record key; jurisdiction_facility_id is only unique within jurisdiction_code and is never used alone. registered_business_name/abn/acn belong to the operator business role, not the facility; no legal form or entity_type is inferred from names or ABN presence. first_report_year/latest_report_year are NPI reporting-year labels, not incorporation or licence dates. primary_anzsic_class_* describe the facility's primary activity, not a company-wide industry classification. reports is a report count, not an emissions measure, and the facilities table alone does not evidence emissions or environmental compliance. latest_report_url is a link, not a stable identifier. No constants are used.

concepts.definition: The national NPI facility identifier assigned by the National Pollutant Inventory, unique across all jurisdictions. Identifies the facility across snapshots; it is not the operator's ABN/ACN.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.establishment.source_key is a generic publisher site code; the NPI national facility identifier is a distinct, nationally unique key that must not be conflated with the state-scoped jurisdiction_facility_id, so a dedicated concept preserves the correct identity semantics.

concepts.definition: The state/territory-scoped NPI facility identifier. Only unique within its jurisdiction_code, so it must always be qualified by the jurisdiction and never used alone as a key.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept captures a jurisdiction-scoped facility identifier; ext.establishment.source_key is a single publisher code and would lose the required jurisdiction qualifier.

concepts.definition: The Australian state or territory code under which the NPI registers the facility (e.g. QLD, SA, WA, NSW). Qualifies the jurisdiction-scoped facility identifier.
concepts.why_not_existing: address.state is the business's address state; the NPI jurisdiction code is the facility's registration jurisdiction and is a required qualifier for the jurisdiction-scoped facility id, so it needs its own establishment-owned concept.

concepts.definition: The ANZSIC class code the NPI states as the facility's primary activity classification. Describes the facility, not the company-wide industry.
concepts.why_not_existing: entity.industry_code and ext.entity.industry_code are business-owned and company-wide; the NPI value is a facility-level primary classification and must not be promoted to the operator.

concepts.definition: The ANZSIC class name the NPI states for the facility's primary activity classification, in the publisher's wording.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds a facility-level ANZSIC class label; ext.entity.sector_tag is business-owned and scheme-qualified for other purposes.

concepts.definition: The source-stated free-text description of the facility's main activities (e.g. 'Pig Farming', 'WINEMAKING'). Kept in the publisher's wording; not an invented industry code.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.entity.sector_tag is a business-owned scheme tag; this is a facility-level free-text activity statement that must remain verbatim and establishment-owned.

concepts.definition: The NPI reporting-year label (e.g. '2003/2004') of the facility's first NPI report. A reporting-year label, not an incorporation or licence date.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds an NPI reporting-year label; ext.entity.date_established and entity.date_registered are business dates and must not be conflated with reporting years.

concepts.definition: The NPI reporting-year label (e.g. '2024/2025') of the facility's most recent NPI report. A reporting-year label, not a compliance or licence date.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds an NPI reporting-year label; it is distinct from first_report_year and from any business date concept.

concepts.definition: The number of NPI reports the facility has submitted, as stated by the source. A count of reports, not an emissions measure or compliance indicator.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.establishment.capacity counts patrons; no existing concept holds a facility's NPI report count, and it must not be read as an emissions quantity.

concepts.definition: The NPI identifier of the facility's most recent report, as published. Identifies the report, not the facility.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds an NPI report identifier; it is distinct from the facility identifier and from the report URL.

concepts.definition: The published URL of the facility's most recent NPI report. A link only; it embeds state/year/jurisdiction-facility path segments and is not a stable facility identifier.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.contact.website_domain holds a registrable host, not a full report URL; no existing concept captures a report link, and it must not be treated as an identifier.

reuse.ext.establishment.name: facility_name is the site/premises name, matching the establishment-owned site name concept.
reuse.ext.establishment.geo: latitude/longitude are facility coordinates, matching the establishment geo point concept (lat,lon).
reuse.entity.abn: abn is the operator's Australian Business Number, matching the business-owned ABN concept; validate checksum.
reuse.entity.acn: acn is the operator's Australian Company Number, matching the business-owned ACN concept; frequently blank.
reuse.entity.legal_name: registered_business_name is the operator/registered business entity name, matching the business legal name concept; it is not the facility name.
reuse.entity.website: facility_website is a published website for the operator/facility, matching the business website concept.
reuse.address.full: street_address is the facility street address, matching the full address concept.
reuse.address.locality: suburb is the facility locality, matching the address locality concept.
reuse.address.state: state is the facility state, matching the address state enum.
reuse.address.postcode: postcode is the facility postcode, matching the address postcode concept.

unmapped.reason: Duplicates jurisdiction_code for these rows; mapped to address.state for the facility address, but the NPI registration jurisdiction is captured separately as dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_code to avoid conflating address state with registration jurisdiction.
